valuation_basis: Historical sensitivity case prepared after the signal. Annualize consolidated nine-month revenue by 4/3 under the same consolidation scope. Construction is seasonal.
bridge_basis: Book-value proxy for separately reported financial investments and associates; keep project receivables and investment property in operations. Deduct cash equivalents. Debt uses separately identified financing lines, including current maturities.
margin_basis: Hold the reported nine-month core operating margin before finance costs, investment income, other gains and impairments constant for all five forecast years and perpetuity.
assumption_basis: Illustrative nominal CNY sensitivity: standard 25% enterprise income tax, one yuan of reinvestment per yuan of additional revenue, 9% required return and 8% terminal ROIC. Long-run 2% growth and symmetric +3%/-3% explicit scenarios are research assumptions.
